selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Treat W1-01 UI as a Booking-local operational list/create/detail experience; global shell and authentication remain W2-01 even when broader enterprise mockups exist.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Inherit the W2-02 operational-console visual language for W1-01 only; adapt it to the journey without importing global shell, full design-system migration, fake capacity, D&D, or broader equipment behavior.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: When a mandatory named reviewer cannot start because its fixed model is unsupported by the active Codex account, retry through an independent default sub-agent that loads the same reviewer persona and preserves the same read/write boundary.

selections.heading: Corrections
